facts.value: Initialization resets pending count and head. The callback accepts events 1 and 2 while count <= 256, writes at (head + count) % 256 and increments count. The consumer protects each removal with interrupt disable/restore, but the enqueue body has no explicit interrupt guard. Only the first 256 slots of the 262-word allocation are indexed under normal nonnegative state.
facts.rationale: Correct the concrete queue bound, conditional recovery, callback installation or caller scope.

facts.value: Drains events until count is zero, with interrupt exclusion only around removal. READY clears two companion fields and attempts FIOInit; success sets the FIO flag, while failure only prints NG and does not clear a previously set flag. MCCOpen and status polling continue regardless of FIOInit success. Open failure or unsuccessful polling through the three-second tick threshold invokes usb_exit_init; status 3 is accepted before the timeout test. Successful MCC connection resets flags 0..15 then enables 0,8,15. REBOOT calls the companion query, restarting on zero and discarding on nonzero. facts.rationale: Correct the concrete queue bound, conditional recovery, callback installation or caller scope.
